sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Stafford Town on Saturday 28 November looking to extend their excellent recent form. Sandbach have won their last two league matches and sit top of the table with 37 points from 17 games, though they will face a Stafford side in respectable form themselves with one win in their last three league outings.
divisionWide: Second-placed Wolverhampton Casuals, in exceptional form with six consecutive league wins, travel to fellow in-form side Allscott Heath on Saturday before hosting New Mills on Tuesday. The chasing pack includes AFC Bridgnorth at home to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday, while fourth-place Stafford face Sandbach. Eccleshall host Barnton on Saturday as fifth-place Eccleshall look to bounce back from their recent loss. Telford Town v Widnes Town on Saturday sees two struggling sides meet, with Telford having won once in their last five. Alsager Town begin the week away at Barnton on Tuesday evening before facing Brereton Social on Saturday. Crewe travel to Allscott Heath on Saturday, while Foley Meir host New Mills on Saturday and Wednesfield Community welcome Shawbury United to a midweek fixture on Tuesday before hosting Barnton the same evening. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Dawley Town on Saturday in an early kickoff.
